scope: Independent AI meaning review of root-authored PCM Korean course unique indexes 500–749; all 250 fields individually compared with English reference and canonical Korean questions/targets/options. Reviewer did not author this PCM pack and did not modify it.

crossQuestionFindings.farewellDirection: 624/637 and linked 575/635 keep leaving vs staying recipient correctly.
crossQuestionFindings.meaningCollisions: book/water/house/apple, person/country/sky/mountain/flower/river and greeting/thanks/apology choices remain distinguishable. No wahala for 괜찮아요 and for 천만에요 is contextually separated by reply-to-thanks label; no examined question has both as indistinguishable alternatives.
crossQuestionFindings.gender: No him/her or name-based sex inference found. Minsu/Mina remain names. Generic Dem in reading instructions is not a new fictional group.
crossQuestionFindings.sharedVocabulary: Identical school, book, water, yes/no, Thank you, Congratulations, Sleep well and I understand can be shared Pidgin vocabulary; exact English spelling alone is not evidence of fallback.

optionCollisionSupplement.limit: No exact normalized option-label collision found in checked sets; this supplements the source-target meaning assessment, not a native idiom approval.

editorialNote.reason: Many generated fields put a final full stop outside a quote already ending in sentence punctuation. Cosmetic cleanup is recommended; protected Korean/romanization should remain exact. This is not a material meaning rejection.

limitations: Independent AI review, not Nigerian Pidgin native-speaker/teacher approval. Three Pidgin aspect entries are explicitly uncertain. Register recommendation should be assessed by a native reviewer. Structural checks supplement actual meaning review and are not used as semantic approval. No target/source/code/deployment/commit edits.
